title: Void Vault Merkle Proof
description: Proof that a specific audit entry is included in a session's Merkle tree.

session_id.description: The session whose Merkle tree contains this entry.

entry_index.description: Index of the audit entry within the session.

entry_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the target audit entry.

merkle_root.description: Root hash of the session Merkle tree.

tree_size.description: Total number of leaves (entries) in the Merkle tree.

hash.description: Sibling hash at this tree level.

position.description: Whether this sibling is on the left or right.

proof_path.description: Ordered list of sibling hashes from leaf to root.
